# Floor

Rounds a number down to the nearest integer.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Floor(value)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | number | The number to round. Null, or a value that is not a number, is a runtime error. |

## Returns

Number. The greatest integer that is not above value, so a negative number goes away from zero. The result is exact when value is exact. Never null.

## Example

`Floor(2.7)` returns `2`.

`Floor(-2.1)` returns `-3`.
